mapper.sql: bbs15_company_rule_id AS company_rule_id, bbs15_company_id AS company_id, bbs15_rule_type AS rule_type, f_cdnm('CompanyRuleType', bbs15_rule_type, bbs15_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS rule_type_name, bbs15_company_rule_cd AS company_rule_code, bbs15_title AS title, bbs15_content AS content, bbs15_note AS note, bbs15_seq AS seq, TO_CHAR(bbs15_revision_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS revision_date, bbs15_revision_no AS revision_no, (bbs15_public_yn = 'true') AS public_yn, TO_CHAR(bbs15_close_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS close_date, bbs15_cre_nm AS cre_name, bbs15_upd_nm AS upd_name, COALESCE(TO_CHAR(bbs15_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS upd_date_str, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = bbs15_company_rule_id) AS file_cnt
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_cnt , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm11_task_relate_rule WHERE tdm11_company_id = bbs15_company_id AND tdm11_relate_type = '2' AND tdm11_rule_cd = bbs15_company_rule_cd ) AS relate_cnt FROM bbs15_company_rule WHERE bbs15_company_id = #{companyId} AND bbs15_company_rule_cd = #{companyRuleCode} GROUP BY bbs15_company_id, bbs15_company_rule_cd

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm11_task_relate_rule INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON tdm10_task_id = tdm11_task_id INNER JOIN tdm21_role_relate_task ON tdm21_task_id = tdm10_task_id INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm21_role_id WHERE tdm11_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm11_relate_type = #{relateType} AND tdm11_rule_cd = #{ruleCode} AND EXISTS ( WITH tdm30 AS ( SELECT * FROM tdm30_role_allc INNER JOIN tdm34_role_allc_detail ON tdm34_role_allc_id = tdm30_role_allc_id WHERE tdm30_company_id = tdm11_company_id AND tdm30_role_id = tdm20_role_id ) /*--개정일 이후 책무배분이 일어난 경우--*/ SELECT 1 FROM tdm30 WHERE tdm34_role_allc_date >= #{revisionDate}::date UNION ALL /*--개정일 이후 책무기술서가 등록된 경우--*/ SELECT 2 FROM tdm30 INNER JOIN tdm31_role_desc ON tdm31_person_id = tdm30_person_id WHERE tdm31_reg_date >= #{revisionDate}::date )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs15_company_rule (bbs15_company_rule_id, bbs15_company_id, bbs15_rule_type, bbs15_title, bbs15_content, bbs15_note, bbs15_seq, bbs15_work_date, bbs15_revision_date, bbs15_revision_no, bbs15_public_yn, bbs15_company_rule_cd, bbs15_close_date, bbs15_cre_nm, bbs15_upd_nm, bbs15_upd_date) VALUES (#{companyRuleId}, #{companyId}, #{ruleType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{note}, #{seq}, f_sysdate(), #{revisionDate}::date, #{revisionNo}, #{publicYn}::text, #{companyRuleCode}, #{closeDate}::date, #{creName}, #{creName}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE bbs15_company_rule SET bbs15_rule_type = #{ruleType}, bbs15_title = #{title}, bbs15_content = #{content}, bbs15_note = #{note}, bbs15_seq = #{seq}, bbs15_work_date = f_sysdate(), bbs15_revision_date = #{revisionDate}::date, bbs15_revision_no = #{revisionNo}, bbs15_public_yn = #{publicYn}::text, bbs15_company_rule_cd = #{companyRuleCode}, bbs15_close_date = #{closeDate}::date, bbs15_upd_nm = #{creName}, bbs15_upd_date = now() WHERE bbs15_company_rule_id = #{companyRuleId}
